episodes.185832: A waterspout developed off the shoreline of Sheboygan on the evening of October 31st under lake effect showers, as colder air spilled south over Lake Michigan.
episodes.186342: A strong system moved across the Great Lakes with weak lake induced CAPE of 100 to 300 J/KG and strong low level forcing, which resulted in the development of showers across SE Lake Michigan. A report of a funnel cloud and waterspout were shared on social media in the nearshore areas. No damage was reported.
episodes.186507: Already saturated soils due to between 3 to 7 inches of rainfall across central portions of Puerto Rico during the previous week and up to around an inch of rainfall on that day |(Oct 31st) served to trigger a Debris Flow in Aibonito.
episodes.186554: Winds became gusty behind a cold front on October 30th, 2023 across the Chesapeake Bay.
episodes.186555: Winds became gusty behind a cold front on October 30th, 2023 across the James River.
